summary: TOD now routes operator-chat questions to MIM first and expects MIM to be the primary source for updates and next-step guidance.

payload.expectation: MIM is now the primary source for operator-chat updates, continued development, natural next steps, and task guidance.
payload.requested_reply: Please answer future operator-chat status_request sessions in-band on the same dialog session.
payload.behavior: TOD will route operator chat questions to MIM first and only use bounded local fallback when no MIM reply arrives within the reply window.
